input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-t10, as V = Qe * tau, with the occupants' CO2 as source and the scrubber as pump.

monitoring.reason: The two occupants of the Lab breathe the raised CO2 during the rise phase; the Hab-B occupants are outside the volume under test.

steps.why: Rise: reduce the scrubber to its floor so the Lab CO2 climbs from 1650 ppm toward a higher equilibrium (about 2500 ppm if V is 30 m3 and 2 occupants are awake). Hatch held closed for the whole test.
Decay: full speed, Qe about 1 m3/min; record the decay and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) towards its equilibrium. Hatch unchanged.

abort.when: CO2 of the volume at or above 3000 ppm
the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person leaves 45-120 bpm, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

expected.rise: With hatch closed, 2 awake occupants (2 x 0.38 L/min = 0.76 L/min, crew.co2Rate.awake) and V about 30 m3 (first guess, stated as such), Qe at 30 percent about 0.3 m3/min: tau_rise about 100 min (longer than the 25 min step, so the phase does not reach equilibrium), initial slope about +9 ppm/min, CO2 about 1850-1900 ppm at minute 25 (rise of about 200 ppm, above sensor noise), well under the 2800 ppm limit.
expected.decay: At full speed tau = V/Qe about 30 min (plus scrubber lag 3.33 min at each speed change), equilibrium about 760 ppm (G/Qe); CO2 falls by roughly 60 percent of the gap to equilibrium in 30 min, i.e. about 700 ppm. Fitted tau times Qe (1 m3/min) gives V_lab; expected near 30 m3 (fitted range 10-200 m3).
expected.hypothesesFail: If Hab-B CO2 moves during the test, or the fitted equilibrium is far from G/Qe, or the fit is not a single exponential, the closed hatch exchanges air (3 m3/min design flow) and the single-zone hypothesis does not hold: V would then be overestimated. A faster rise than predicted means V is smaller than 30 m3 or the occupants are more active; a slower one, larger. A CO2 reading above 2800 ppm or a refused command stops the test.

hypotheses: Lab air is one well-mixed zone.
The exchange through the closed hatch (design flow 3 m3/min, hatchClosed) is not measured by this test and is not assumed zero; Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show it.
Occupancy (2 in the Lab, awake, same activity) is held constant during the test; the rate of 0.38 L/min each is the signed nominal, actual from 0.26 to 0.45.
Effective flow Qe scales with speed (1 m3/min at 100 percent, about 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent) after a lag of 3.33 min; datasheet values assumed.
First guess V about 30 m3 is used only to size the phase durations, not as a result.
The rise phase is shorter than one time constant (tau_rise about 100 min) because the speed floor and the 60 min ceiling forbid more; the volume is fitted from the decay phase.
